problem_and_result: A Gateway caller could pass its final wait check, retire across a true session boundary, then restore old session grants or clear replacement denial state. Three callers now reuse the same captured producer for a post-wait owner-guard then approval-lock transaction. Current validation and bounded memory writes are atomic with retirement; stale once/session/always decisions return a typed denial.
supported_behavior: Three retired caller grant regressions and two replacement denial reset regressions are closed without changing their original assertions.
Current once/session/always consent, parallel FIFO/nonsharing and exact unregister behavior remain useful.
Smart-DENY override remains one operation. Tirith warning scope stays session-only; combined permanent persistence is called zero or one times after the bounded memory transaction.
No transport, wait, hook or disk I/O is held under the new owner/approval lock section. Legacy bare callbacks retain their previous behavior without typed ownership qualification.
